summary: Roadmap Gantt chart with dithered progress bars, a pulsing milestone and a today line; bars drag or resize, snapping by day.

events.name: change
events.detail: { task: string, start: number, end: number }
events.description: Fires when a drag that moved or resized a bar ends, and on each arrow-key move or resize. `task` is the task name; `start` and `end` are day offsets from 5 October 2026, from 0 to 41.

keyboard.action: Move the focused bar one day earlier or later.
Shorten or lengthen the focused bar by one day at its end.

accessibility: Each bar is a native button with an `aria-label` such as `Design: Oct 9 to Oct 18, 100% done`; the milestone reads `Launch: Nov 11`.
The status next to the heading is an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces the dates of the focused or moved task.
Task names are text in a column beside the chart. Bars, grid and today line are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, bars appear without growing in, moves snap instead of easing, the milestone does not pulse and the today-line glint is hidden.
notes: Tasks are built-in demo data: six rows over 42 days (weeks 41 to 46 of 2026), ending in a Launch milestone that cannot be moved.
Drag a bar to move it, or drag within 10px of its right end to resize it. Bars snap to whole days.
The today line is fixed at 25 October 2026, not the current date.
Rows are 34px tall and the chart fills the width.

data.note: The six tasks, their dates and progress and the today line are invented; only `label` can be set.
